name: Panarottis Garden Route Mall
address: Shop 85, Garden Route Mall, 72 Knysna Rd, George, 6529, South Africa
description_short: Family-friendly Italian at Garden Route Mall serving wood-fired pizzas, pastas, and breakfast all day.
description_long:
Located in Garden Route Mall, Panarottis offers a relaxed family dining experience with all the Italian classics done well. The wood-fired pizzas are a favourite, with generous toppings and proper crispy bases, while the pasta selection covers everything from creamy carbonara to classic bolognese.

The atmosphere is casual and welcoming, making it ideal for families with kids or groups meeting for a meal after shopping. Breakfast is served all day, so whether you're after eggs Benedict mid-morning or a pizza for lunch, they've got you covered. The dessert menu includes proper Italian gelato and indulgent chocolate brownies.

Conveniently positioned inside the mall with ample parking, it's an easy stop whether you're a local or passing through George. Service is friendly and efficient, and they offer takeaway if you'd rather enjoy your meal at home.
